artworks.title: Moonrise from the River
artworks.medium: softground etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 5.6 × 9.8 cm (2 3/16 × 3 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon featuring dense foliage. An orb is visible slightly to the right above the horizon. The sky blends with the land in a tranquil gradient. The painting style is delicate with sparse brushstrokes. The color palette is limited to shades of gray and brown, creating a subdued and contemplative atmosphere suggestive of dusk or twilight.

artworks.title: Monaco from La Condamine, Monte Carlo
artworks.description: The image depicts a coastal scene with buildings on a rocky hill, a subtle horizon line where the sea meets the sky, clouds overhead, intricate lines defining the landscape and buildings, a monochrome color palette of black and white, boats on the water, and a person rowing a boat.

artworks.title: Portrait of Miss Hetty Pettigrew
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 26.3 × 14.8 cm (10 3/8 × 5 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, standing and facing forward. She has soft facial features, curly medium-length hair under a hat, and is wearing a dress with an off-the-shoulder collar, a large bow, and a belt at the waist. The background is textured gray with no other objects.

artworks.title: The Alcove
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 12.6 × 17.3 cm (4 15/16 × 6 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a full-body view of a person in a side position facing the right. The person is seated with legs extended in front, arms raised near or touching the head. The individual has dark hair, and facial features are somewhat subtle due to the stylized artwork. The figure is nude without any visible accessories or items. The background is textured and dark, with soft strokes hinting at a curtain or drapery.

artworks.title: The Terrace, Monte Carlo, End of Afternoon, April 1905
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 15.1 × 23.6 cm (5 15/16 × 9 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a viewpoint by the water with people walking and talking on a promenade. There are elegantly dressed individuals, including a woman in a long dress and hat, engaging in conversation. Ornate street lamps frame the scene on both sides. The horizon divides the sea from distant land covered in dark foliage. Mountains rise in the background under a sky with soft clouds. The artwork has a monochromatic palette, and delicate linework creates a serene atmosphere. The scene is softly focused.

artworks.title: Corner of Luna Street, Chelsea Embankment
artworks.medium: etching in green on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 16.4 × 14.2 cm (6 7/16 × 5 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people near a fence with ships' masts in the background. The scene appears to be near a harbor. The artwork uses fine lines to depict texture and movement. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of deep blue-green. A tree is depicted among the figures and ship masts, with its leaves rendered in short, sweeping strokes.

artworks.title: Corner of Luna Street, Chelsea Embankment
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 16.3 × 14.2 cm (6 7/16 × 5 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a busy street scene with various figures and structures. The horizon is blocked by buildings and ship masts. Tall ships with large masts are prominent. The etching features detailed, sketchy lines for texture. The color scheme is monochromatic. A tree with textured leaves is in the foreground, with people in period attire. Figures interact, creating a lively atmosphere. Ships' masts are visible in the distance, hinting at a harbor setting.

artworks.title: Parson's Green, Afternoon, End of Winter, The Duke's Head
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to platemark): 18.7 × 22.2 cm (7 3/8 × 8 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a street scene with a central building, benches, a fence, and trees. The central building appears to have intricate architectural details. The scene includes people, horse-drawn carriages, and clouds in the sky. The artwork is created using detailed etching techniques with fine lines, providing texture. The color palette is monochromatic in varying shades of sepia or light brown, giving an aged look.

artworks.title: The Children's Hour, Summer Evening, Parson's Green
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 8.3 × 5.1 cm (3 1/4 × 2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a park scene with a lamppost, figures sitting on a bench or barrier, and people walking in the distance. Trees fill the background with intricate patterns created by their branches, blending with the foliage-covered horizon. The artwork is an etching with fine lines and cross-hatching to depict textures and shadows, in monochromatic tones of gray and black, giving a calm and detailed visual impression.

artworks.title: Trees in Moonlight
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 9.6 × 7 cm (3 3/4 × 2 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays an abstract view with textural quality. It appears like a clouded sky or misty landscape with indistinct forms. The horizon is not clearly defined. The brushstrokes are soft and diffuse, creating a mysterious and atmospheric effect. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly black and grey. The texture suggests complexity, though details are elusive, prompting interpretation from the observer.

artworks.title: A Nymph Bathing, Moonlight
artworks.medium: softground etching, aquatint, and drypoint on Van Gelder laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 12 × 8.1 cm (4 3/4 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts dark, swirling shapes with areas of light breaking through, forming an abstract composition. In the center, lighter areas suggest the silhouette of a seated figure. The contrast between the dark and light elements creates an abstract landscape.

artworks.title: A Stag, A Study
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 6 × 8.9 cm (2 3/8 × 3 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts swirling and curly lines and shapes spread across the canvas. In the center, a silhouette resembling a deer with antlers is visible against a textured backdrop. The patterns give an abstract appearance, resembling curly plant tendrils or streams of air.

artworks.title: Poppy in a Vase
artworks.medium: softground etching, aquatint, and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 9.8 × 6.6 cm (3 7/8 × 2 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a large poppy flower with a seed pod connected by a long stem, placed above a vase with floral designs. The color palette consists of dark tones of black and brown. The poppy flower is positioned in the upper left, with the seed pod extending towards the left edge. The stem curves from the upper section to the lower right, leading to the vase at the bottom right, which includes a detailed leaf.

artworks.title: Portrait of Miss Edith Austen
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 14.8 × 9.8 cm (5 13/16 × 3 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person's head and shoulders with soft facial features and curly hair styled in a loose bun. The person is facing straight ahead with their head slightly turned to the right. The clothing has a high neckline and there are no visible accessories. The background is plain with a textured, shaded effect.

artworks.title: Head of Girl Leaning on Her Hand
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 6 × 5.6 cm (2 3/8 × 2 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a woman's head and partial upper body. The woman has her head slightly tilted downward and turned to the side. Her face is softly drawn with closed eyes, a small nose, and a subtle smile. She has dark, wavy hair falling around her face and shoulders. The woman appears to be wearing a simple garment. The background is textured with marks and details, and there are inscriptions on the drawing, including the artist's signature at the bottom.

artworks.title: Head of Girl Leaning on Her Hand
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 6.1 × 5.6 cm (2 3/8 × 2 3/16 in.)

artworks.title: Two Flowers
artworks.medium: softground etching on J Green & Son wove paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 7.9 × 6.8 cm (3 1/8 × 2 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features two flowers, one with spiky petals on the left and another with a more open and rounded shape on the right, each rising on their slender stems. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black used to depict the flowers against a lightly textured beige background. The open flower with rounded petals is positioned slightly above and to the right of the spiky flower in the composition.

artworks.title: Profile of a Woman
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 16 × 11.8 cm (6 5/16 × 4 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting with their upper body slightly turned to the side. They have light, smooth hair and delicate facial features, with their eyes looking down and lips closed. The person is wearing a dark gown that exposes their shoulders and upper chest, and their right hand is holding the neckline of the gown. The background is dark and undefined, emphasizing the person in the foreground.

artworks.title: The Saw Mill, Putney
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 11.7 × 7.7 cm (4 5/8 × 3 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a building next to a river, depicted through etching. The view is frontal with the building as the main focus. High horizon line outlined by the building's roof, trees, and some structural elements. Small figures walking along the riverbank. The color palette is monochromatic, from tan to dark lines, emphasizing architectural and natural details. In the background, loosely sketched trees and clouds give depth to the scene.

artworks.title: The Gate, Chelsea
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 20.9 × 16.5 cm (8 1/4 × 6 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate wrought iron gate with intricate swirling patterns and floral motifs. The gate is in the center of the image, with no visible horizon. In the background, there is a building facade with windows partially obscured by leafy trees casting shadows on the ground. The foliage and shadows have fine, delicate brushstrokes creating a textured effect. The color palette is monochromatic sepia, giving the image an old-fashioned feel. Dark and light contrasts enhance depth and details, creating a calm and slightly mysterious atmosphere.

artworks.title: Chelsea Children, Chelsea Embankment
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 18.9 × 13.3 cm (7 7/16 × 5 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene from a low viewpoint, with buildings on the right side and a street stretching into the distance. No distinct horizon line is visible in the image, as buildings and trees dominate the upper portion. In the foreground, a group of people, including women and children, are gathered around a seated figure near a tree trunk. The brushstrokes are etched and sketch-like, creating a textured depiction. The color palette is monochromatic with black and white shades. Trees add linework in the upper portion, enhancing depth.

artworks.title: Laburnums and Battersea
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in olive green on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a series of slender, bare trees framing the view. In the distance, there are buildings with a clock tower. The artwork uses delicate, linear brushstrokes to create an etching-like texture. The color palette consists of sepia tones, providing a warm feel. The trees and ground close to us have finely hatched lines. The area beyond the trees shows more structures. The sky above is open and light.

artworks.title: Study from the Nude of a Girl Standing
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 12 × 8.2 cm (4 3/4 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person standing in a full-body side view. The person's left hand is on their hip, emphasizing the curve of their back and hips. Their right arm is hanging by their side. The person's profile shows a straight nose and slightly parted lips. They have long hair in a braid down their back. The person is depicted nude, without any clothing or accessories. The background is a neutral surface with faint, vertical lines. Hand-written text or a signature is present in the top left and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Study from the Nude of a Girl Standing
artworks.medium: drypoint in red on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 12 × 8.1 cm (4 3/4 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person in full-body profile view. The person is standing upright with their hands on their hips, weight seemingly distributed on one leg. The facial features are minimal, showing a distinct chin and nose. The individual has long hair tied back or styled in a ponytail, resting down their back. The person is unclothed, emphasizing natural curves and posture. The sketch does not show any jewelry or objects. The background is plain with visible sketch lines, focusing on the subject.
